environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule overridden to COUNT, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' at priority 200 containing a single rule that uses a RegexPatternSet matching URI-decoded query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:union[\s/\*]+(?:all[\s/\*]+)?select|select[\s/\*]+(?:(?:[\w.*]+[\s/\*]*,?[\s/\*]*)+from)|'[\s/\*]*(?:or|and)[\s/\*]+['"]?\w+['"]?[\s/\*]*[=<>]|--[\s]*$|;[\s]*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete))` with action BLOCK and text transformation URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE applied to AllQueryArguments, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in default BLOCK mode. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics are enabled for all rules with sampled requests.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, ACM certificate, target group on port 8080
